cohort: Women with any form of diabetes in pregnancy undergoing early term scheduled cesarean section (ETSCS)
finding: Maternal corticosteroid administration was associated with significantly higher rates of neonatal hypoglycemia, while rates of RDS/TTN were not significantly different.
mod_finding: The study investigated neonatal outcomes following early term scheduled cesarean section in pregnancies complicated by diabetes, but did not examine specific modes of delivery beyond this.
